// Classifier fixture, vitest: EMPTY and its negative. Read as text by tests/classify.test.ts.
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { createPost } from "../src/posts.js";

describe("empty", () => {
  it("creates a post", async () => {
    await createPost({ title: "x" });
  });

  it("creates a post with its title", async () => {
    const post = await createPost({ title: "x" });
    expect(post.title).toBe("x");
  });

  it("creates a post with an id", async () => {
    const post = await createPost({ title: "x" });
    if (post.id === undefined) {
      throw new Error("the post has no id");
    }
  });
});
